name: tradeos
description: TradeOS MCP for ChatGPT: ticker search, historical candles, market snapshots, and technical analysis of XAUUSD, stocks, crypto, and forex.

interface.longDescription: Connect TradeOS to ChatGPT to search tickers, retrieve historical price and volume candles, view the latest available market snapshots, and analyze XAUUSD, stocks, crypto, and forex across multiple timeframes. Compare spreads and relative strength, identify support and resistance, and interpret technical indicators. TradeOS provides analysis for research; trading decisions remain with you.
capabilities: Retrieve historical price and volume candles
defaultPrompt: Analyze XAUUSD across daily and weekly charts with key levels and momentum.
Compare NVDA against SPY for trend and relative strength.
Show AAPL's latest available market snapshot and daily candles.
